title: The Cloudburst Test: What Catalonia's October 2026 Floods Say About Industrial Climate Risk
detail: Barcelona logged 190.8 mm in one night, double its 2017 record. A standard river-flood model sees almost nothing at the region's plants; the carbon bill is the bigger number, and the flash flood is the one nobody has priced.
author: Shrinivash D Kannan
